messages.content: Help me generate a DMG setup script for an application named 'PhotoEditor' located at '/Applications/PhotoEditor.app', with a custom background image and ensuring the script reflects the correct volume URL and installation directory when creating a macOS package using jpackage?

function.name: MacDmgBundler_prepareDMGSetupScript
function.description: Prepares a DMG setup script for a macOS application package, including the volume URL, background image file, and installation directory. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

appLocation.description: The file system path string to the application location. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.

params.description: A map of parameters that may include the application name, images root, background image folder, and other packaging parameters. This is Java HashMap type parameter in string representation.

We need to call the function MacDmgBundler_prepareDMGSetupScript with appLocation '/Applications/PhotoEditor.app' and params string containing a map. We need to provide a JSON string representation of a Java HashMap. The map should include application name, images root, background image folder, etc. The user wants a DMG setup script for PhotoEditor located at /Applications/PhotoEditor.app, with custom background image and ensuring script reflects correct volume URL and installation directory when creating a macOS package using jpackage.

{
  "appName": "PhotoEditor",

  "backgroundImageFolder": "/path/to/backgrounds",

Actually, when creating a DMG, the volume name is usually the application name. So volume URL might be "file:///Volumes/PhotoEditor". The install dir is "/Applications".

We also need to include the custom background image. That might be specified by "backgroundImageFile" or "backgroundImagePath". Let's include "backgroundImageFile": "/path/to/background.png".

We need to produce a JSON string representation of a Java HashMap. That means we need to produce a JSON object as a string. For example:

"{\"appName\":\"PhotoEditor\",\"imagesRoot\":\"/path/to/images\",\"backgroundImageFolder\":\"/path/to/backgrounds\",\"volumeURL\":\"file:///Volumes/PhotoEditor\",\"installDir\":\"/Applications\",\"backgroundImageFile\":\"/path/to/background.png\"}"

But we need to decide what keys are expected by the bundler. The function description says: "A map of parameters that may include the application name, images root, background image folder, and other packaging parameters." So we can include those keys. The bundler will use them accordingly.

Thus we call the function with:

appLocation: "/Applications/PhotoEditor.app"

params: "{\"appName\":\"PhotoEditor\",\"imagesRoot\":\"/path/to/images\",\"backgroundImageFolder\":\"/path/to/backgrounds\",\"volumeURL\":\"file:///Volumes/PhotoEditor\",\"installDir\":\"/Applications\",\"backgroundImageFile\":\"/path/to/background.png\"}"

We need to produce the function call. Then the function will return the DMG setup script. We need to output the result. So we call the function.
